settlement.note: PAYMENT-RESPONSE was observed on the fixture transport. This example does not prove on-chain settlement.

attemptReceipt.note: When --attempt-receipt is set, unsigned nonce/validBefore/paymentIdentifier are persisted before paid send for a separate read-only reconcile. Chain usage still does not imply delivered output or retry permission.

boundary: Transparent bounded @x402/fetch integration example with optional unsigned attempt receipt. Not a durable-budget buyer, not automatic retry, and not native Claude/Goose payment capability.
